items.text: share on the launch screen, between install and index: send the link, copy it, or show a QR code
after joining as a founding tester, share Current with a friend
joining as a founding tester says thank you with the duck-rabbit and confetti, then closes
the founding tester sheet closes after you join (its × works, and it closes by itself)

a Mic tab in the sound panel: presets (room, whisper, voice through, feedback), input, voice or raw, gain, a noise gate with a meter, and heard, which sends the mic to the speakers (feedback is yours to play)
a phrase looper: record a few seconds from the mic, free or 1, 2 or 4 bars in time with the beat, forward or reversed; it plays as a loop channel in the mixer
How it works: an (i) in the sound panel slides up the explanation for the open tab
become a founding tester, from the launch screen
mic, your music and mix share a band on the sound shelf; the caret above it opens the sound panel, and holding mic opens the Mic tab
three saved beats are free; more saves and beat export will come with Pro
Bytes keeps one short line under the formula; the rest folds into How it works
the mixer has tabs: Mixer, Beat and Bytes
Beat: a sixteen-step grid to make your own beats, play them live and save them as presets
the bytebeat writer moved from the index into the mixer, under Bytes
Auto comes first in the keyboard order too, the way it reads
Terms in the Colophon: Current is in beta, some new features will become Pro, and anything free stays free
the Auto symbol leads its slider's row, left of the name, so it reads as that slider's
